name: Dwarven Thrower

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Dwarf or a creature attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind

summary: +3 warhammer that can be thrown (20/60 ft) and flies back; an extra 1d8 when thrown (2d8 against Giants).
text: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Thrown property with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, it deals an extra 1d8 damage or, if the target is a Giant, 2d8 damage. Immediately after the attack, the weapon flies back to your hand.
